question: Costs in Case T-36/23 Stevi and The New York Times v Commission
Several months have passed since the Commission’s last answer of 9.12.20251 on the legal costs associated with Case T‑36/23. How much has this case cost thus far?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (28.7.2026) Since the replies given to the previous written parliamentary questions1 submitted by the Honourable Member on the same issue, no new elements have been brought to the Commission’s attention. Therefore, the Commission has to reiterate that, at this stage, the amount of the legal costs connected to case T-36/23 have not been liquidated and it is not yet possible to quantify them.
